caption: The drawing depicts a single, turned wooden object resembling a mallet or pestle, positioned vertically against a plain, off-white background. The object is predominantly brown with varying wood grain textures, suggesting it is made of a single piece of wood. At the top, there is a circular, flat surface with a rounded edge and subtle concentric detailing. The shaft tapers slightly with two bulged, ring-like collars, one near the top and the other near the middle, separating three distinct cylindrical sections of the handle. The bottom end is more bulbous and rounded, with visible wood grain pattern and darker shading, suggesting wear or use on this end. The surface of the object is rendered with fine lines and shadows, highlighting the details of the wood grain and the turned structure.
title: Potato Masher
